Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Permission to publish Brighton Health case spotlight & logo

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the time last week. We drafted a short customer spotlight that highlights Brighton Health's work with Redwood Inference (attached) and would love to publish it on our resources page and share it in a short social push. We also wanted to request permission to use the Brighton Health logo on the case study landing page and in related marketing collateral.

Attached: brighton-draft-case-study.docx (draft case write-up) and redwood-logo-guidelines.pdf (our usage guide so your team knows how we'll present both brands).

Quick notes / asks: 
- Would Brighton be willing to approve the draft for publication?
- Can we use the Brighton Health logo (SVG or PNG) on the asset and on marketing landing pages?
- Any legal/comms language or trademark restrictions we should follow?
- If approved, do you have an internal approver we should send a final sign-off doc to (or would you prefer we send through DocuSign)?

If helpful, Rafael (copied) can coordinate timelines on our side. Ideally we'd publish the week of Dec 6, but we can move to suit your review process.

Thanks — and happy to jump on a short call if you'd prefer to walk through the draft.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@brightonhealth.com>

Subject: Re: Permission to publish Brighton Health case spotlight & logo

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for sending this over and for the clear asks. The story looks good at a high level; I have a few questions before I can push it through our comms/legal review: 

1) Which Brighton execs are quoted in the draft? (I want to confirm permissions for those specific quotes.)
2) Do you require any implied exclusivity or endorsements beyond the case study? We typically avoid language that could be construed as a product endorsement.
3) Will any customer data be shown in screenshots (we need to redline any PHI or identifiers) — I didn't see obvious screenshots, but please confirm.

On logo usage: our legal team will need: (a) a usage statement confirming where you plan to use the logo (web, ebooks, social), (b) a short specimen showing placement, and (c) a limited-time permission window (we usually grant 2 years).

I've looped Legal and Samir (CS lead) — Legal will advise on wording and Samir will confirm the quote approvals.

Best,
Elena
VP, Marketing Operations
Brighton Health

3) Screenshots: There are no screenshots of customer interfaces or data in the attached draft. If we add any images later we'll submit them for a separate approval.

Permissions requested: web case study, resources page, social promotion (LinkedIn/X), and inclusion in one short sales enablement PDF. If Brighton prefers a time-limited permission window, we are fine with a 2-year term.

Laura (Legal) — could you please weigh in on a short permission statement and give us a small sign-off doc we can send to Brighton for an exec signature? Rafael — can you confirm expected publish timing on our side?

Thanks,

Hi Elena / Brighton Legal —

Thanks for reviewing. I've prepared a short permission letter with limited terms that should meet Brighton's requirements while keeping the process lightweight. Key points:
- Grant of non-exclusive, revocable license to use the Brighton Health name and logo strictly in connection with the case study and related marketing (web, social, and a single sales PDF).
- Permission term: 24 months from the date of signature.
- No implied endorsement; we will include a plain-language disclaimer.
- No customer data or screenshots will be published without separate written consent.

I've uploaded a signable PDF to DocuSign for convenience: https://www.docusign.com/embeddedSigning/xyz-approve-4497

Please review the attached redlines (I put short suggested edits in the paragraph on quotes and the disclaimer). If Brighton is comfortable, an authorized signer can execute via the DocuSign link or return a signed PDF. Happy to make any edits to the scope as needed.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Compliance
Redwood Inference
